description: The balloon around one chat message. The user's own messages are green on the right, replies are light on the left. 16px radius.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Seven variants for different senders and situations, including ghost (no balloon) and destructive (failed to send).

actions.title: Reactions & clickable suggestions
actions.description: BubbleReactions sits on the balloon's corner. With asChild, BubbleContent becomes a button, e.g. for suggested questions.

parts.group: Stacks several balloons from the same sender.
parts.bubble: Wrapper; sets the variant and side (left/right).
parts.content: Text inside the balloon. Supports asChild.
parts.reactions: Emoji reactions on the balloon's corner.

props.align: "end" = right side (the user's own messages). Inside Message it follows the message.
props.asChild: Render the child element (button or a) with balloon styles.
props.side: Reaction position: above or below the balloon.
